description: Schema for deterministic per-file Lean4/clean frontend exit-status artifacts consumed by generate_frontend_classification.py. The generator treats absent artifacts as missing evidence and present artifacts that violate this schema as stale_or_invalid evidence.

field_constraints.engine: must equal lean4 or clean and match the path engine segment
field_constraints.filename: must equal the corpus filename, including .lean
field_constraints.source_sha256: must equal the current sha256: digest from tests/lean4_compat/MANIFEST.json
field_constraints.command: must be a non-empty array of non-empty strings
field_constraints.status: must be success when exit_code is 0 and failure otherwise
field_constraints.observed_process_status: optional; when present, must be exited or timeout
field_constraints.observed_timeout_seconds: optional; required and positive when timeout evidence is recorded
field_constraints.failure_mode: optional; must explicitly name timeout when timeout evidence is recorded

timeout_evidence_rule: timeout exit-status evidence must use a nonzero exit_code and status failure; it is bounded evidence only and cannot claim successful process completion
